=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:~509-518 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Summary unconditionally emits ", {semble_rendered} semble, {read_fallback_rendered} read" in else branch even when both counters are 0 (no Semble/read retrieval occurred).
  WHY: Non-Semble calls (no --semble-* flags or Semble fail-open) hit else branch (inlined < included due to overflow markers), producing e.g. "(1 inlined, 1 marker-only, 0 semble, 0 read)" instead of legacy "(1 inlined, 1 marker-only)"; violates issue #2302 "preserve existing whole-file inlining behavior byte-for-byte" and breaks callers/tests expecting unchanged non-Semble output shape.
- tests/test_targeted_file_context.py:~330-364 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Test asserts legacy "Included 2 entries (1 inlined, 1 marker-only), " but calls emit_context without Semble args (big.py overflows to marker, inlined=1 < included=2, semble_rendered=0, read_fallback_rendered=0).
  WHY: Emits "Included 2 entries (1 inlined, 1 marker-only, 0 semble, 0 read), ..." mismatching assert; test fails on PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 tests/test_targeted_file_context.py, blocking CI despite passing other paths.
- scripts/targeted_file_context.py:~583 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: Passes _bounded_query_text(plan_text) without prior strip-or-None check.
  WHY: plan_text=None/empty passes through as None (handled), but whitespace-only plan_text strips to empty (returns None correctly); no failure, but inconsistent with prior (plan_text.strip() or None) intent.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
